record.question: The simple method of recording earthquakes with the use of rods failed because:
options: They were not sensitive enough to detect gentle earthquakes
They did not record severe earthquakes
They failed to record the direction from where the earthquake came
record.explanation: The passage says gentle shocks topple only the unstable rods while severe shocks topple all of them, so the rods failed to register gentle earthquakes.
